steps.name: Raucous Crowd
steps.text: Hurry up! It's already 13:00! As soon as we finish lunch we need to start cooking! Golden carrots must be first on the list! Trust me. It's not a real feast without golden carrots!

steps.name: Raucous Crowd
steps.text: Where are the plates? There aren't enough plates here! Where are the bowls? And we'll need at least twenty more tables, and chairs! My thirteenth uncle's second aunt came too, and she's bringing her five little kids. How exciting!

steps.name: Raucous Crowd
steps.text: Hey! The whole reason I came here was to cook for you! So what if I'm a guest? Are you seriously not going to let me cook? Hurry up and hand me the spatula!

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Come here, Sandbeast.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: You're not afraid of all this noise? You... like it?

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw! Wraw!

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: Hey, Jerry, look! I see Ray over there!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Oh! Hey, Ray! We're over here!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Is someone calling me?

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: —over here!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Oh, Jerry! It's you!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: I'm so sorry. There are just so many people here. I yelled as loud as I possibly could!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: After Keira and I got back from our honeymoon, I wanted to throw a thank-you party for you. Then somehow the guest list just kept growing... Still, I'm really happy with how it turned out!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Because no one here would have thought that Keira and I would end up together, after we both ran away from the altar...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Jerry... It's awfully noisy here. I can't hear what you're saying!

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: Can you speak a bit louder?

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: I SAID...

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: THAT KEIRA AND I...

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: ARE VERY GLAD YOU COULD MAKE IT!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Okay. I heard you that time!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Oh—and I have to say, Keira and I both think that if you hadn't been there, so much of what followed wouldn't even have happened!

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Keira and I wouldn't have ended up running away and then meeting like that! We wouldn't have gotten to know each other so quickly! And everything else that happened afterward... WE TRULY HAVE TO THANK YOU!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Ah. I heard that too!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Did I make that much of a difference, really?

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: OF—COURSE!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: If you hadn't hijacked the truck, maybe Keira and I would never have met up! Who knows when or if I'd have my family pushing me down another path.

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: That is why we're so grateful to you, Ray!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR THE HIJACKING!!!

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Hijacking? Did you hear that? Did I get the word wrong?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: I remember Jerry said he was carjacked. They crashed through the checkpoint and had a fight with the guard. That was all her doing?

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: What? I can't hear you! You're saying that she stole Jerry away?

steps.name: Seventeenth Sister
steps.text: What? It's too noisy! You're saying she jacked the truck... for Jerry?!

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: What?! She crashed through the checkpoint and had a fight with the guard, only to hijack the truck and take Jerry away?!

steps.name: Raucous Crowd
steps.text: WHAT?!

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Sorry, Ray, but we still have so much to do. Do you still remember where you're sitting?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Yes. Pavilion 3, near the geyser, table 12, seat 6.

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Warmy will be to the left of you, and Alanna to the right. There's also a wooden crate there for your sandbeast.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Ray, you just have to try our cooking tonight! OKAY! See you later!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sure!

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: (Happily stretches its backfin)

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: (Happily digs into the sand)

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Now, sandbeast. This isn't your personal playground. You can't behave like that.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw! Wraw! Wraw! Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: You've been so hyper ever since we got back to Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Sandbeast.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I've saved up a bit of money. We don't have to work tomorrow. Let me take you out to the wilderness for a little while right now.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I know you want to go run in the wilds, dig tunnels, and play with the sand.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Look! It's right over there. I'll stay here and build us a little shelter. You go on ahead. I'll keep an eye on you.

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw! Wraw—wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sandbeast, let's go out and play while we have the chance.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Long ago I took a sandbeast, my first sandbeast, to the wilderness to play.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It was so happy, as happy as you are now.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: (Points out the window towards the wilderness)

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Let's go have some fun, yeah?

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: (Rubs excitedly)

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: First we'll go get a map, and then we'll find you some snacks. Then we'll borrow Lanns's car.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Has that girl been talking to the sandbeast ever since Jerry and Keira left?

steps.name: Seventeenth Sister
steps.text: She jacked a truck so she could take Jerry away...

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: She looks like she's in bad shape...

steps.name: Seventeenth Sister
steps.text: Huh? Look... she left already? She doesn't even want to stay for the meal?

steps.name: Seventeenth Sister
steps.text: That doesn't seem right. I think you lot should follow her. Don't leave her alone!

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: I've been following her from a distance, don't worry. After she left, she went straight to that little shop outside town—probably to buy something.

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Yup. I saw her walk in there. Don't worry. I'll go over there and get a few more groceries. What do you all need?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Cystymilk, onions, cheese... okay, got it.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Lanns said it was here, from what I remember... preserved corpses, skeletons, photographs...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Here's the place. Easy.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Hello? Is anyone here? I'd like a map showing the locations of large sandbeast caves nearby.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Huh? Who are you? Maps? You came here for 'Fins on the Night Desert' too?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I heard that legend before, but that's not why I'm here.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Then why are you here? What do you all think this is, a wishing well that anyone can stop by?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I'm a pitsinker. These are my old work credentials, medical report, and attendance records… If you help me, I can take you to any abandoned mine or underground cave you want to visit.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: What do you think about that?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Now that's new—never seen anyone like you, coming here like you're applying for a job or something. Alright, let me take a look...

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Oh? You actually managed to tame that little thing?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: No. It just followed me here on its own.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Followed you here? Huh. Interesting.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: This is... a Rhodes Island dining card? You're from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Alright—you've worked as a pitsinker, you can tame a sandbeast, and you're a Rhodes Island operator... If the Doctor picked you, you must have some skills. Here, take the map.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Leave me your contact. Next time I want to explore a cave, I'll contact you.

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Alright. I've finished my shopping. Let me see where she is... huh? Wait a minute, she... what is she going to that shop for? Is that... an animal carcass... and is that a corpse?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: No. There's just no way I can let her stay in that kind of place by herself. I need to go see what's going on! Oh this is awful!

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Hey! Unhand my guest!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Wha? What now? Where did you come from?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Whoa? Huh? Where is she? Where did she go?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: Dammit! I lost track of her!

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: Don't worry. I was on my way back from rinsing out some old barbecue barrels in the mines, and I saw her coming right this way after I got your message.

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: Yes, she was there with the sandbeast. I'm sure you'll see her in another ten minutes or so.

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: You still need four more barbecue barrels, huh? Alright. I'll bring them over right away!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sandbeast, look over there. We've found what we were looking for.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: The mushrooms and moss that grow in the mine tunnels... they're tasty and good for your health. They can help sandbeasts purge toxins.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Well, today you can eat a little less feed and instead snack on some moss and mushrooms. Think of it as 'picnic food'!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Come with me. We'll go find some.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sandbeast, hold on to me tight. We're about to head down.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: Hey! Hey! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: Uh oh. I've got some bad news. I was just finishing brushing one of the barrels when I saw her go down into the mine!

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: To make matters worse, it's an abandoned mine. I don't dare go in there myself. I'll stand guard at the entrance until she comes back up!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I heard a sound coming from up above us. Did you hear it, Sandbeast?

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Munchmunch...

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Maybe it was the wind.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Hey. Don't eat so much. We need to bring some moss and mushrooms back with us, you know.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: If you eat so much that we exceed the lift's weight limit, we won't be able to get back up there.
Twenty minutes later...

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: *burp*

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Good. Let out another burp, and maybe we'll still be able to use the lift.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw! Wraw!

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: *burp*

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Okay. Great. Grab on tight. We're gonna go back up now.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Now we have only one thing left to do. We're going to ask Lanns if we can borrow her truck.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: We still have enough time left.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Lanns, I want to borrow your ute.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Huh? Why? You're travelling?

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: You're not going to the banquet, Ray? I made my sweet meat soup!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It's not that. I just suddenly have the urge to take Sandbeast out for a stroll.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I'll be back before the banquet starts.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You sure you'll come back?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Yes. Last time I left the ship to watch the burdenbeasts dancing under the moon, I got in trouble.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: The HR Operator said next time I have to report in first, to avoid interrupting everyone's work.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: You told me that before I make a decision, I need to stop and think about it first.
Ray stops for a second and thinks about it.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Well I've thought about this one. Jerry and Keira keep telling me how much they want to thank me. If I don't come back for the banquet, they'll be very hurt.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: So... I'll definitely be back.
Ray finishes speaking. She looks as if she's finally figured out the answer to a major question, and she gives a small nod to herself.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Yes. I'll come back for the banquet.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Wow. I never thought you'd actually remember what I told you! Alright then. Here are the keys. Be careful out there.

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Right, Ray, well, you have to try my sweet meat soup at the banquet, yeah?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Of course. I will.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alright then. I'd best be going.

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: *huff huff* I finally finished greeting each and every guest, and arranging all their seats... I'm exhausted!

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: Well, let's take a little break...

steps.name: Keira
steps.text: It feels so good now that I've gotten all that done...
Help! Something terrible happened!

steps.name: Keira & Jerry
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: No no no... We lost her! Who here has seen that quiet Cautus girl?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: I watched her go into this horrifying hut—it was full of bones and corpses, and the woman inside looked terrifying. I have no idea what happened to her in there!

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: After Ninth Auntie lost track of her, she immediately sent us a message. I happened to see her nearby, but I was a step too late—she went straight into an abandoned mine shaft. I called for her over and over, but no one answered!

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: Huh? That can't be right. I just saw her here. She was driving a truck, heading over that way!

steps.name: Keira & Jerry
steps.text: Who? Which way?
Sixth Uncle points his finger at the window.
Everyone looks over towards the window—a trail of dust gradually fades into the horizon.

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: She was heading south. There aren't any mines or villages over there because of all the sandbeast burrows. It's kind of a no-man's land. Is she... in trouble? Does she have a death wish or something?

steps.name: Keira & Jerry
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: Jerry, she hijacked a truck for you before. Come on. You can't just let her run around by herself over there like that!

steps.name: Keira & Jerry
steps.text: What?!
The sandbeasts lounge about, stirring up the sand as they slowly trudge across the boundless desert, enjoying the cool night air.
The transport vehicle comes to a stop in the distance. One woman, and one beast, jump out from it.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Look, Sandbeast. We're here.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Here. I'll rearrange your moss and mushrooms for you. There we go.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Go out and play. You'll love it.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw—!
The little sandbeast lets out a joyful cry and charges into the pack up ahead. It merrily rolls around, rubbing up against all the other sandbeasts.
The pack doesn't reject the newcomer. Instead, they warmly welcome its arrival, gently nudging it and sniffing its scent.
They are all carrying the same mushrooms and moss, which occasionally emit a faint glow when they bump into each other.

steps.name: Pack of Sandbeasts
steps.text: Wraaaaw—

steps.name: Pack of Sandbeasts
steps.text: Wraw—wraw—

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw! Wraw!
Ray is carrying those same mushrooms and moss, and thus, emits the same occasional faint glow herself. She breathes in the fresh scent of the plants and slowly trails after the pack.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Here, Sandbeast. Eat up.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I looked these mushrooms and moss up in a book. If you eat them, the color of the veins on your back will go back to normal, and you'll feel better.

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Kwh—kwh—!

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Kwh...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Do you feel any better?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sorry. I'll stay close by your side and pay more attention to your health from now on, Sandbeast, especially when we're cleansing infected creatures.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I won't let you get more than five steps away from me.

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw...

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw, wraw.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: You stood up! Are you better now?

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw, wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Oh! I'm so glad, Sandbeast!
Ray reaches out her hand and strokes the sandbeast's backfin, inspecting the color of the veins to make sure it has really recovered.
The sandbeast snuggles its head against Ray's hand and shifts into a comfortable position in her arms.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sandbeast...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I've saved up a bit of money. We don't have to work tomorrow. Let me take you out to the wilderness for a little while right now.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I know you want to go run in the wilds, dig tunnels, and play with the sand.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Look! It's right over there. I'll stay here and build us a little shelter. You go on ahead. I'll keep an eye on you.

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw! Wraw—wraw!
The sandbeast runs off excitedly into the wilderness, but quickly turns back around and gently nudges its head against Ray's ankle.
It's almost as if it's asking her to venture with it into the wilderness.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: You want me to go play with you?

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Oh, Sandbeast! Calm down! I'm about to lose my balance here! You've spilled mushrooms and moss all over me!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Oh look. After you bump into them... they start glowing?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It's actually quite pretty.

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraaaaw—

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I guess we'll keep wearing them then.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Alright. Let's go have some fun. I'll put off building the hut for a bit.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Follow me, Sandbeast!

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: These sandbeasts... sometimes when they are digging underground, they will dig into the mines.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Is that how they learned that these mushrooms and moss... remove toxins?
The sandbeast pack, of course, aren't able to answer the Cautus's question, even though she's wearing the same mushrooms and moss that they are.
They happily jostle to and fro, lighting up the mushrooms and moss hanging from their bodies, before ravenously gulping them down.
In the darkness the pack seems to float effortlessly across the desert, like a huge school of fins swimming slowly toward the glimmering moonlight.
Ray stands there, watching them.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: This is the first time I've ever seen anything like this. I guess the 'Fins on the Night Desert' is a real thing.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I guess... they were talking about sandbeasts...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: And my Sandbeast.
Ray starts running... and her faint glow returns.
She catches up to the sandbeasts, like a wayward fin returning to its school.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: (Whistles)

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: *huff* *huff* ... Sandbeast!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sandbeast! Should I give you a proper name?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: A name for my first sandbeast!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: What's a good name for you?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I'll call you... 'Glowy'?

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Don't like that name?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: 'Shiny'? 'Lighty'?

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Haha. No. You don't like any of those names...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I don't think I'm too good at picking names.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Let me noodle on it a bit more...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Well you keep saying 'wraw' 'wraw'... how about I call you 'Rory' for now?

steps.name: 'Rory' (for now)
steps.text: Wraw?!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Relax! Relax!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Oh come on! Jerry and Keira just explained everything to you—it was all a misunderstanding! Ray didn't hijack the ute to run off with Jerry, and she wasn't trying to commit suicide in the wilderness!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: She just wanted to take her sandbeast out to have some fun. It's no big deal. You don't need to worry.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: If you don't believe me, ask Potlid!

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Yes. Lanns is right. Ray said she'd be back in time for the banquet.

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: The banquet is scheduled to start at 21:30. She still has two minutes to get here.

steps.name: Half-believing Crowd
steps.text: Is she really going to come back safely?

steps.name: Half-believing Crowd
steps.text: We really don't need to go find her?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Believe me. Ray promised me that she'd be back!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's almost 21:30. Listen to me...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Let the banquet—begin!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: *huff* I'm back.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Let me think... oh right, I'm seated at pavilion 3, near the geyser, table 12, seat 6.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Potlid is sitting to my left, and Lanns is sitting to my right. There's also a wooden crate for Rory.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Right. This is the place.

steps.name: 'Rory' (for now)
steps.text: Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Wow. The barbecue smells wonderful. The stew doesn't look half bad either...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: What's wrong? No one wants to eat?

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: Uhh... We'd like to ask...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Sixth Uncle
steps.text: You didn't drive that truck into the no-man's land... because you suddenly lost your marbles and wanted to do something stupid?

steps.name: Ninth Auntie
steps.text: You didn't go into that terrifying hut to buy poison, and/or something equally awful?

steps.name: Fourteenth Brother
steps.text: You didn't have some kind of mental breakdown, get lost, and end up in that abandoned mine?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: What are you all saying? Of course not!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I took it out on a picnic.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Look.
Ray holds up the sandbeast at her feet, whose belly is now full and round.
The little sandbeast fidgets just slightly.

steps.name: 'Rory' (for now)
steps.text: *burp*

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: See! I told you!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Well, let's eat!
